question: Zakir Hussain is associated with which musical instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tabla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Zakir Hussain:-**

 
 
• He is associated with the musical instrument Tabla.
 
• Zakir Hussain is a renowned Indian musician and composer who is considered a master of the tabla. He has won several awards and accolades for his contribution to Indian classical music. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Santoor:-**

 
 
• It is a stringed musical instrument that originated in Persia and is now popular in India.
 
• It is played with a pair of wooden mallets and has a unique sound that is soothing and melodic. 
 
 
 
• **Sitar:-**
 
 
• It is an Indian stringed instrument that has been used in classical music for centuries.
 
• It has a long neck and a pear-shaped body, and is played with a plectrum and finger techniques.
 
 
 
• **Piano:-**
 
 
• It is a Western classical instrument that has keys and hammers that strike strings to produce sound.
 
• It is not typically associated with Indian classical music, although some musicians have experimented with incorporating it into their compositions.
